Genspark is your All-in-One AI workspace that puts busywork on autopilot. Just prompt it, and let Genspark handle the rest.
 
SUPER AGENT

• Ask anything, get answers quickly and accurately

• Autonomously researches topics and collects comprehensive info for you

• Generates stunning images, videos, and audio with simple prompts
 
AI SLIDES

• Just prompt it, autonomously creates boardroom-quality decks

• Auto-researches and enriches content to deepen your presentations without manual effort
 
AI SHEETS

• Just prompt it, and Excel runs on autopilot—auto-collects info, auto-builds formulas, auto-builds templates

• From raw data to insights in seconds
 
AI DOCS

• Just prompt it, autonomously drafts professional docs

• Hundreds of intelligent templates adapt to your needs, not rigid constraints
 
AI DEVELOPER

• Just prompt it, autonomously builds websites, native apps, and games

• Full GitHub integration for development workflows with code editing and pull requests
 
AI MEETING NOTES

• Autonomously transcribes meetings and generates awesome notes

• Shares meeting notes with all participants effortlessly in one click
 
AI CHAT

• Free chat with all top-tier AI models like GPT, Claude, Gemini, and Grok, always up-to-date
 
AI IMAGE

• Free use with all top-tier image models like Nano Banana Pro, GPT Image, FLUX, and Seedream, always up-to-date
 
AI VIDEO

• Free use with all top-tier video models like Gemini Veo, Sora, Kling, and Seedance, always up-to-date
 
That's just the beginning—explore AI Designer, Photo Genius, Clip Genius, AI Pods, Deep Research, and much more. Experience the next generation of productivity with Genspark—where your busywork goes on autopilot.
